principles: No metric value without a declared unit, method, scale, input digest, source or model version, evidence class, and uncertainty statement.
Missing or inapplicable inputs yield unknown/not-computable, never zero or favorable.
Targets and weighting belong to explicit project/participant/authority decisions, not hidden global defaults.
Distinct outcomes remain a vector of evidence; no universal sustainability score is emitted.
Schematic symbol anchors are not footprints, species inventories, surveyed geometry, or simulation-ready domains.

metrics.label: Shade fraction at a declared time
required_inputs: georeferenced area of interest with area-preserving CRS or qualified area method
terrain and obstacle geometry with source and resolution
solar position inputs: latitude/longitude, date, local time and time zone
failure_modes: local schematic frame has no geographic location
missing terrain/building/canopy geometry
solar/timezone metadata absent
shadow model outside validity envelope
metrics.target_policy: set by project objectives and required time windows; never silently assume noon represents all heat exposure

candidate_sources.limitation: A 30 m digital surface model is regional terrain context, not a site-grade terrain or building/canopy model; exact tile CRS, vertical datum, quality and terms must be verified.
10–60 m bands and seasonal/cloud effects do not provide accurate individual-tree crowns, obstacle heights or surveyed shadows.
Exact orthophoto/topographic product, acquisition date, CRS, map scale and redistribution rights must be checked; it is not presumed to be a survey.

unprovided_inputs: Georeferenced area-of-interest geometry and qualified area method
Current surveyed or validated 3D obstacles/canopy geometry
Latitude/longitude, date, local time and time-zone inputs
Validated shadow algorithm and independent reference checks

metrics.label: Runoff volume for a named rainfall event
metrics.formula: integral(outflow_discharge(t) dt) over the explicitly named event and model boundary
required_inputs: event rainfall hyetograph or calibrated design storm and provenance
versioned hydrological model and calibration/validation record
failure_modes: catchment boundaries invented from a schematic canvas
missing rainfall or soils
unvalidated solver or missing calibration
unknown downstream boundary conditions
metrics.target_policy: compare named baseline and proposal under identical event inputs; do not infer runoff reduction from green-colored drawing symbols

candidate_sources.limitation: Daily 0.05-degree rainfall context is not a design-storm hyetograph, local gauge record or calibrated runoff boundary condition.
A 30 m surface model may include buildings and vegetation; it cannot establish small-site drainage paths or invert elevations.
Exact product scale, date, contour/elevation availability, vertical reference, licence and accuracy must be checked.

unprovided_inputs: Site catchment and drainage network geometry
Soil/infiltration and imperviousness measurements
Local rainfall intensity-duration-frequency data or validated event hyetograph
Initial conditions, calibrated model and independent discharge/volume reference

metrics.label: Tree canopy cover fraction
required_inputs: area of interest with valid spatial frame
observed crown polygons or species/age-specific validated crown models
source, date, resolution and overlap handling
failure_modes: using rendered tree glyph extents as crown geometry
overlap double-counted
future crown assumed without species and age evidence
mixed-resolution data presented as parcel precision
metrics.target_policy: state target and time horizon separately from existing observed canopy

candidate_sources.limitation: Multispectral 10–60 m imagery supports broader vegetation screening but is not itself an individual-tree crown footprint inventory.
Exact orthophoto product/resolution/date and rights must be verified; crown delineation and field validation are still required.

unprovided_inputs: Valid area of interest and spatial frame
Observed tree-crown polygons or validated species/age-specific crown models
Tree establishment date and growth assumptions
Overlap union method, source dates and independent crown reference

metrics.label: Planting elements with verified species evidence
metrics.formula: 100 * planting elements with species identity plus qualifying source/method evidence / planting elements whose species identity is required and known
required_inputs: declared treatment of unknown and not-applicable cases
failure_modes: counting decorative planting-bed symbols as species
assuming native status from a common name alone
unknown plants silently removed from denominator
metrics.target_policy: species appropriateness and biodiversity effects require separate metrics; completeness is not a biodiversity gain score

candidate_sources.limitation: Regional CBA/ESA planning classes are not a taxonomic species inventory or proof of native status for a planting list.
Priority-area layers guide screening; they do not identify the species in the authored planting schedule.

unprovided_inputs: Species-level planting schedule
Versioned taxonomic reference
Local flora/native-origin source at the target ecoregion
Field or curator verification and explicit treatment of unknown species

metrics.label: Maximum longitudinal grade along a declared accessible route
metrics.formula: 100 * max(abs(change_in_elevation) / horizontal_run) across validated path segments
required_inputs: path centerline geometry, not a rendered stroke
elevation profile with vertical/horizontal units and accuracy
failure_modes: symbol stroke interpreted as route centerline
vertical datum missing
segment too short for stable grade estimation
applicable standard not declared
metrics.target_policy: threshold is jurisdiction/project-specific; do not claim compliance without the applicable standard and complete required checks

candidate_sources.limitation: OSM road/trail geometry may be incomplete or stale and does not establish route grade, surface condition or accessibility compliance.
Product scale/elevation data and rights are unqualified until the exact map or orthophoto asset and metadata are selected.

unprovided_inputs: Designed or surveyed path centerline (not rendered stroke width)
Elevation profile with vertical/horizontal units and accuracy
Applicable jurisdictional accessibility standard and version
Surface, route continuity and landing/cross-slope checks required by that standard

metrics.label: Embodied carbon total for a declared scope
metrics.formula: sum(material_quantity_i * declared_emission_factor_i) for all in-scope material items, lifecycle stages, and system boundaries
required_inputs: quantity take-off with units and uncertainty
material/product-specific EPD or declared LCI factor
factor dataset/version, geography and declared lifecycle stages
failure_modes: inferring quantities from schematic icons
double-counting reuse/recycled flows
mixing incompatible lifecycle boundaries or factor years
treating missing EPD as zero carbon
metrics.target_policy: report range and per-scope breakdown; compare alternatives under the same boundary and dataset versions
unprovided_inputs: Versioned material/product EPD or declared lifecycle-inventory factors
Quantity take-off tied to real geometry and units
Geographic/year validity of emission factors
Explicit lifecycle stages, reuse/substitution and biogenic-carbon accounting boundaries

metrics.label: Required maintenance obligations with an assigned responsible party and cadence
metrics.formula: 100 * obligations with an accepted responsible party, cadence, and review trigger / all obligations in the approved project maintenance plan
failure_modes: assuming identity implies authority
counting an unaccepted assignment as complete
no expiry/review state
publishing private contact or land data by default
metrics.target_policy: coverage does not prove maintenance execution or survival; report observed completion separately
unprovided_inputs: Versioned maintenance obligations and accepted assignments
Mycelix consent/role/authority record reference
Monitoring cadence, trigger and review/expiry policy
Privacy policy for people, land and sensitive ecology records

metrics.label: Lifecycle cost range over a declared analysis horizon
metrics.formula: Sum of capital, operations, maintenance, replacement, and end-of-life cashflows over a declared analysis horizon, with declared discount and scenario conventions.
required_inputs: quantity take-off and rates with source date/geography
analysis horizon, base year, inflation and discount conventions
failure_modes: icon counts used as bill of quantities
local and imported cost rates mixed without explanation
future costs expressed in inconsistent currency/base years
discount rate hidden
metrics.target_policy: publish low/base/high range with assumptions; do not merge cost with ecology or equity into an opaque scalar
unprovided_inputs: Geometric quantity take-off and local supplier/labour rates
Source geography, currency and price base year
Operations/maintenance/replacement schedule
Analysis horizon, inflation and discounting conventions
